name: Generic types (any company, any era)
note: Company-neutral fallback types (rakes plan 1a; research doc 12d; D5a, D8, D18). Lengths are Matt's choices, each anchored to a measured LMS vehicle where one exists, and are shown as approximate. The parameters below are the generic defaults: the buffer allowances are the only measured figures so far (LMS vehicles); the train limits copy the LMS 1939 table, the only source so far.

params.trainLimitsNote: LMS 1939 limits (research doc 8c). Mapping to the app's train types is an inference: fitted freight No. 1 = 1/2 fitted (50), No. 2 = 1/3 fitted (55); 4 braked as No. 2; other goods 100, mineral 90.
